editorial:
Imagine being a genius scientist who can't walk, but you have the brainpower to build a high-tech suit that turns you into a human weapon. That is exactly what happens here. You get to follow a man who creates the M.A.N.T.I.S. suit to fight back against a city full of criminals. The vibe feels like a classic 90s comic book come to life, mixing a bit of crime drama with some really cool sci-fi gadgets. It is an inspiring story about overcoming physical limits and taking justice into your own hands when the police just cannot handle the chaos.

You will likely enjoy the steady pacing and the way the suit's abilities are revealed. The acting is solid, and while some of the effects look a bit old now, they actually add to the nostalgic charm. If you love underdog stories and early superhero tropes, you should definitely give this a shot. Since it is an older TV movie, your best bet is tracking down a DVD copy for your physical collection or checking if it is available for rent on Apple TV. If you find a remastered version streaming in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, grab it immediately for the best experience.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head in a final showdown where the hero uses the suit's full power to take down the main villains. After a tense fight, he proves that his mind is his strongest weapon, not just the metal suit. The movie wraps up with the city finally feeling safer. He accepts his role as a protector, showing that his disability does not stop him from being a true hero.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves 90s sci-fi and comic book style stories.
